BiblicalUsage: Ahiram was a son of Benjamin, named once in the second census, where the family of the Ahiramites is traced to him. Beyond this verse the Bible tells no more of him.
TheologicalSignificance: A census line is all we get for him, and I will not stretch it into a sermon. The family is remembered because the tribe was counted.
